tool_smoke.method: Windows QPA MainWindow and standard bindings; foreground/exposure checks determine validity. input_delivery distinguishes independent Qt-posted operations from foreground-guarded Win32 SendInput. SendInput is injected OS input, not physical keyboard/IME validation. Paint is completed QWidget dispatch, not DWM presentation. Nearest-rank quantiles and raw samples; 8ms heartbeat and 20ms working-set sampler. Isolated settings/files; autosave/update checks disabled; recovery-draft timers retained. Final drafts are requested and acknowledged asynchronously before the drained memory checkpoint.

method: Complete raw records retained, including every latency tail and focus-invalid run. Qt-posted events are processing diagnostics, never physical keyboard evidence. Native mode sends Win32 virtual-key SendInput pairs only while the selected window is foreground; it is injected Windows input, not physical hardware. Foreground zero aborts before injection. Missing Win32 foreground observations are unknown, not acceptance. Off disables product perf scopes/stage timers, minimal records aggregate scopes, detailed adds event traces. All modes retain probe clocks, paint hooks, heartbeat and working-set sampling. Whole-run Qt focus/exposure checks are separate from Windows foreground checks. Paint completion is QWidget dispatch, not DWM presentation. All samples and timelines retained; Input-handler and nested Qt event coverage uses clipped interval unions, never sums. Handler wall-time coverage can itself include scheduling/waits; uncovered time has no assigned blocking cause. nearest-rank quantiles/clock deltas checked independently. End-of-run recovery drafts are requested and acknowledged asynchronously, with timeout, before reporting drained working-set bytes. Working set is not heap size; no population latency or leak conclusion from two repetitions.
